comments.author: Lu Yue
comments.body: How do you get this? Translator says----베네치아 기사작 달성，베네치아 정예함대 수탈 -----Venetian articles achieve a smaller fleet plundering Venetian elite,

comments.author: Carla
comments.body: Wild-eyed guess? Why thank you yes I will! I could see this meaning something along the lines of Venecians have a smaller chance of plundering this quest from Venecian elites, which i would guess to be the fleet that you plunder this from.

comments.author: Steward
comments.body:
I got it when I became a knight as a Venetian.

I haven't tried it, but if you go warring with Venice and sail around outside the port, you should see that fleet.
